name: Disconnector motor operator interface
summary: Shows command and position feedback for the selected motor-operated disconnector.
description: Shows command and position feedback for the selected motor-operated disconnector. A switching-device operating reference adds the specific mechanism or duty context needed to interpret its place in a power circuit. The same basic switching outline can serve different equipment constructions, so the added description must remain attached to its device tag.

In a medium-voltage switchgear drawing, the operating reference helps the reader distinguish the interrupting device from its isolation, earthing and auxiliary-control interfaces. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Operation command and interlocks” at the input and “Disconnector drive action” at the output. A disconnector is not generally a fault interrupter.
